name: NeverApply
tagline: AI job-search agent that finds, matches and applies to jobs with your approval
description:
NeverApply is an AI job-search agent. It searches and matches jobs, tailors your resume for each role, answers screening questions, helps you prepare for interviews, and applies to jobs with your approval.

It also has a hosted MCP server (https://neverapply.co/mcp, Streamable HTTP, OAuth sign-in) so Claude, Cursor, Cline and other MCP clients can use its 15 tools directly. Docs: https://neverapply.co/features/mcp
